findings.issue: Camera zooms in and fully out four times; it zooms out right before every screen switch and back in right after (in/out pumping on consecutive cuts)
findings.cause: ZOOMS array: each zoom is a separate in-hold-out envelope
findings.fix: Continuous camera keyframes: zoom in once, pan between focus points during the in-phone screen slides, slow drift during holds, zoom out once before the CTA

findings.issue: Fictional data contradicts itself: today is Wed but trash reminder says 'Every Tue' while trash is on today's list; notification says bathroom 'Due today' while plan/reminder show bathroom on Thu; rotation 'This week' (Bathroom Jonas, Trash Lea, Vacuuming Sam) contradicts the plan (Bathroom Lea, Trash Jonas, Vacuum Mia)

findings.decision: Applied the recommended copy: headline 'Chores, shared fairly.', button 'Download free', footnote 'iOS & Android'. Revert to the old copy if the brand line must stay.
